title: VTechAGP: An Academic-to-General-Audience Text Paraphrase Dataset and Benchmark Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on document-level text paraphrasing from academic to general-audience abstracts. While it includes a standard 'Ethical Statements' section regarding dataset distribution and copyright (Section H), and evaluates toxicity as a safety metric, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
